title: 第9章 天门功第10章 聚灵阵
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 天门功的核心总结而来可以说是短短的一句话
天门通百窍，虚海纳乾坤
此方世界流传有古代圣人的遗训，圣人把人的身体比作海洋，精神富足的人被称为实海，精神空洞的人被称为虚海，久而久之这个词汇便被化用，用来形容修士们对灵气的储量。
陈昭觉得，其实按道理应该叫做丹田或者灵海更加直观一些，不过这个词已经用了上万年，深入人心，不好更改，只能继续糊涂用着了。
天门，既是头顶天门穴，天门功以此穴为引，吸纳紫气贯通周身窍穴，再借天地灵气重塑根基。
要不怎么说是玄阶功法，比起用蛮力压缩灵气提供压力来扩充虚海的锻灵法，这天门功依靠全身十二条主脉和一百零八大穴共同施压，使得经脉与虚海的拓宽速度为寻常功法的三倍。
按照天门功上的描述，修成此功后，灵力绵长，炼气期时，相较同阶其他功法至少储量更多五成，筑基期时，神识强度比同阶修士高上三成，并且有极大概率突破金丹期。
通看了一遍这本天门功，陈昭觉得，此功必定还有金丹期的版本。
筑基期的内容明显没有写完不说，这功法着重筑牢根基，强化神识，这都是在金丹期才有大用的效果，毕竟对于一般的筑基期斗法来说，灵气够多就行了。
再者，这天门宗的老祖乃是金丹修为，据传五百年内将要突破元婴，若是没有金丹期的功法，这老祖又是如何修炼到金丹圆满的？
而且，这功法虽强于一般的功法，但对资源的需求要远高于一般的功法，同样的修为，需要消耗三倍左右的灵气资源。
是了，这恐怕不是天门宗所原创的功法罢！
陈昭突然大胆猜测道。
此法或许是上古修仙门派所撰写的，那时的灵气资源丰富程度远远超过现在，这功法的消耗在当时恐怕都算不上大吧，只是随着时间推移灵气浓度降低，这些消耗灵气大的功法逐渐失传了。
而这天门宗的金丹老祖在多年前意外得到了这本功法，为了补上这资源缺口才建立的天门宗吧，招收弟子是为了聚集修炼资源，不光大量招收杂役弟子让杂役弟子们练散气功法提高宗门灵气浓度，对杂役弟子极尽压榨，从而培育开采更多修炼资源。
这些还不够的话便四处出击，灭杀小门派，掠夺修炼资源，陈昭最开始的那个宗门恐怕就是成为了天门宗的养料了吧。
很早以前陈昭就觉得，这天门宗说那两座山峰组成的“天门”
故而取这名字，有些过于牵强了，为何不叫双峰宗？不怕被陆地神仙撞毁的话叫世贸大厦宗也行啊！
原来竟是因天门穴而得名。
要知道杂役弟子所领到的天门功，除了是要将灵气反刍出来的逆练版外，还删去了用天门穴吸纳紫气的部分，怪不得即便是灵气充足，杂役弟子也无法反抗正式弟子了，少练一节功了属于是。
这么想来，也难怪天光斩这术法无需要求使用者必须修炼天门功，先前修习锻灵法的陈昭亦能成功释放，大概率这天光斩是那金丹老祖参考其他家的术法，自己研发的吧。
不知这原本和天门功配套的术法是何等呢？陈昭暂时也不去想这方面的问题了。
打开窗户，陈昭静静等到天亮，当那第一缕阳光穿过窗户时，陈昭双手结印，猛敲额头，集中精神于天门穴，随即一缕缕紫气从窗外飘来，摄入天门穴之中，流向十二道主脉。
原本陈昭还担心，吸纳紫气必须返回玄清界，毕竟许多秘境中的太阳都并非真实的，而是用术法模拟出来的人造太阳，自然无紫气可吸纳。
如今这秘境之中的紫气入体，让陈昭松了口气。
不过，这一下，疑惑便更多了。
既然有紫气可吸纳，那这方世界便大概率是有着日月循环的正常的大世界，而非法则缺失的，从大世界分割出去的小世界。
content_en:
The core of Tianmen Gong can be summarized in a short sentence
The gate of heaven connects all the apertures, and the sea of emptiness contains the universe.
There are teachings from ancient saints circulating in this world. The saints compared the human body to the ocean. People with rich spirits are called the real sea, and people with empty spirits are called the virtual sea. Over time, this term has been used to describe the monks' reserves of spiritual energy.
Chen Zhao felt that it would be more intuitive to call it Dantian or Linghai. However, this term has been used for tens of thousands of years and is deeply rooted in people's hearts. It is difficult to change it and can only continue to be used in a confused way.
Tianmen is the Tianmen acupoint on the top of the head. Tianmen Gong uses this acupoint as a guide, absorbs purple energy and penetrates the acupoints all over the body, and then uses the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to reshape the foundation.
Or rather, it is a Xuanjie technique. Compared to the spirit-forging technique that uses brute force to compress spiritual energy to provide pressure to expand the Xuhai, this Tianmen technique relies on the joint pressure of the twelve main meridians and one hundred and eight major acupoints in the body, making the meridians and Xuhai widen at three times the speed of ordinary techniques.
According to the description of Tianmen Gong, after completing this skill, the spiritual power will be long-lasting. During the Qi Refining Stage, the reserve will be at least 50% greater than other techniques of the same level. During the Foundation Building Stage, the intensity of spiritual consciousness will be 30% higher than that of monks of the same level, and there is a high probability of breaking through the Golden Core Stage.
After reading through this Tianmen Kung Fu, Chen Zhao felt that there must be a Golden Core version of this technique.
The contents of the foundation building stage are obviously not finished yet. This technique focuses on building a solid foundation and strengthening spiritual consciousness. These are only effective in the golden elixir stage. After all, for ordinary fighting techniques in the foundation building stage, enough spiritual energy is enough.
Furthermore, the ancestor of the Tianmen Sect cultivated the golden elixir, and it was said that he would break through to the Nascent Soul within five hundred years. If he did not have the skills of the golden elixir stage, how could this ancestor cultivate to the perfection of the golden elixir?
Moreover, although this technique is stronger than ordinary techniques, the resource requirements are much higher than ordinary techniques. The same cultivation requires about three times the spiritual energy resources.
That’s right, this is probably not an original technique created by the Tianmen Sect!
Chen Zhao suddenly made a bold guess.
This method may have been written by the ancient cultivating sect. At that time, the spiritual energy resources were far more abundant than now. The consumption of this method was probably not high at that time. However, as time went by, the concentration of spiritual energy decreased, and these spiritual energy-consuming methods were gradually lost.
The Jindan Patriarch of the Tianmen Sect accidentally obtained this technique many years ago. The Tianmen Sect was established in order to make up for this resource gap. The purpose of recruiting disciples is to gather cultivation resources. It not only recruits a large number of handyman disciples and allows them to practice Qi Qigong to increase the concentration of the sect's spiritual energy, but also squeezes the handyman disciples to the best of their ability, thereby cultivating and mining more cultivation resources.
If these are not enough, they will attack everywhere, kill small sects and plunder cultivation resources. The sect that Chen Zhao started from may have become the nourishment of Tianmen Sect.
Chen Zhao had felt a long time ago that the Tianmen Sect said that the "Tianmen" formed by the two peaks
Therefore, this name is a bit too far-fetched. Why not call it Shuangfeng Sect? If you are not afraid of being destroyed by land gods, you can call the World Trade Center Sect!
It turns out that it was named after Tianmen Point.
You must know that the Tianmen Kung Fu received by the handyman disciples is not only a reverse training version that requires the spiritual energy to be regurgitated, but also deletes the part of using the Tianmen acupoint to absorb the purple energy. No wonder the handyman disciples cannot resist the official disciples even if the spiritual energy is sufficient. It is a waste to practice one session less.
Thinking about it this way, it is no wonder that the Sky Light Slash technique does not require the user to practice Tianmen Gong. Chen Zhao, who previously practiced the Spirit Forging Technique, can also successfully release it. There is a high probability that the Sky Light Slash was developed by the Jindan ancestor by referring to other techniques.
I wonder what this technique originally matched with Tianmen Kung Fu is? Chen Zhao didn't think about this issue for the time being.
Opening the window, Chen Zhao quietly waited until dawn. When the first ray of sunlight passed through the window, Chen Zhao formed a seal with his hands, slammed his forehead, and concentrated on the Tianmen acupoint. Then wisps of purple air floated from the window, were absorbed into the Tianmen acupoint, and flowed to the twelve main meridians.
Originally, Chen Zhao was worried that he would have to return to the Xuanqing Realm to absorb the purple energy. After all, the suns in many secret realms were not real, but artificial suns simulated using magic. Naturally, there was no purple energy to absorb.
Now that the purple energy in this secret realm entered his body, Chen Zhao breathed a sigh of relief.
However, this time, there were more doubts.
Since there is purple energy to absorb, there is a high probability that this world is a normal big world with a sun and moon cycle, rather than a small world separated from the big world without laws.
